title: TOML-driven runner registry — add custom vendors without recompiling
task_body: Today vendor CLIs are hard-coded in convergio-runner. Move the catalog into a TOML file the operator can edit, parse it at startup, expose Registry::for_kind so the executor and CLI both consult one source of truth.
rationale: Historically-failed retrieval case: registry + TOML schema changes often land in config parsing modules that don't share task wording. registry + runner_config + kind own the new abstraction; runner.rs consumes it; lib.rs re-exports; executor defaults + executor pick from the registry; agent_spawn uses the kind type.
